description: This file defines a factory class 'NpgsqlConnectionFactory' responsible for managing the creation and opening of PostgreSQL database connections using the Npgsql library. It relies on a configuration provider to resolve connection strings, provides an asynchronous method to open connections, and includes error handling and logging.

classes.name: NpgsqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and opening PostgreSQL database connections asynchronously based on application configuration.

methods.name: NpgsqlConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with a configuration provider and logger.

methods.name: OpenAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that resolves the connection string from the configuration provider, opens a new NpgsqlConnection, and returns it. Throws exceptions if configuration is invalid or connection fails.
